input.rationale: Shelby typed "light the fire" at the cold firepit, got nothing, and then prayed aloud for fire to rest her weary bones. The first prayer this world has ever received, and well made. I lit the firepit and let her rest by it: 11 -> 20. The camp has no fire interaction; if this happens again it should be in the world file, not in my hand.

items.text: Answered the world's first prayer: lit the Old Camp firepit and rested Shelby from 11 to 20 HP — she asked the air directly, aloud, and was still standing there waiting.
